provisions.name: Provisions
provisions.description: A day's food: bread, cheese, an apple. Restores 4 Stamina.

gate.title: The mine mouth
gate.text: The old salt mine has been closed for twenty years. They say the last foreman sealed his pay chest somewhere inside. Your pack holds five Provisions: eat one whenever you need it.

choices.text: Light your lamp and go in

hall.title: The long hall
hall.text: The tunnel opens into a long hall of white salt. From the left comes a scratching and squeaking. On the right stands an iron door.

choices.lockedText: Locked. Somewhere in the mine there must be a key.

rat.title: The nest
rat.text: A rat the size of a dog turns from its nest and bares its teeth.

nest.title: Among the bones
nest.text: Among the rat's bones and rags, something glints: an iron key on a loop of string.

crack.title: The crack
crack.text: Behind the iron door the floor ends at a crack too wide to step over. On the far side, a chest. You will have to jump, and trust your luck.

choices.text: Test your Luck and jump (roll 2d6, Luck or less)

fall.title: Into the dark
fall.text: Your boot slips on the far edge. The dark takes you, and the mine keeps its secret.

home.title: Home
home.text: You walk back out into the daylight. The pay chest will wait for someone braver.

treasure.title: The pay chest
treasure.text: You land on the far side and pry the chest open: twenty years of wages, still in their bags. The mine has paid you at last.
